create_PathManager_copy: create a PathManager to copy files or directories recursively from source to target path
create_PathManager_mkdirs: create a PathManager to make nested directories with an exist_ok flag
create_PathManager_rm: create a PathManager to remove a file or recursively delete a directory
create_PathManager_get_local_path: create a PathManager to cache a file or directory to a local cache directory
create_mkdirs_helper: create a distributed-safe mkdirs helper that only creates directories on rank 0
